author: John M. Forney
text:
Dana,

You should be shipping cherries soon,  right?   I had a call with the other day and he mentioned that they were trying to get a couple of the guys to work with you.

I want to give you a call next week,  just to see what you are up to.

Later,
JMf

author: John M. Forney
text: I asked for a call and a reply with the right contact.  I have done a good job of keeping the pressure on.

author: John M. Forney
text:
Brenda,
I need to know a few things before I can do anything:
Call me back at your earliest convenience
Write me back with the appropriate person
I am not going to continue to e-mail you.  It is either one or the other.
I may have to come down to Charlotte to talk to you.
JMF

author: John M. Forney
text:
Tom,

Im calling because I read your web page,  and I would like to call you and tell you about lanebridge.    I would like to schedule a call next week for 15 minutes.

Later,
JMF

author: Amr Ibrahim
text: Tom:  Let's talk.  I can get you a rate quickly.

author: Amr Ibrahim
text:
Paul:

I am the territory sales manager for the Midwest for Northgate Industrial 
Partners.  We sell third party CMM inspection services.  Would you be 
available for a short call or if you prefer, a reply with the right contact.

Best regards


AI  
713-853-3037

author: Amr Ibrahim
text:
Hi Denise:

Our last conversation was on October 12, 2001.  I'm writing to give you 
another chance to contact us.  We have a good opportunity to work with you 
on your new project.

Please give me a call at (713-853-3037) or let me know if you have a contact 
that I can give you.

Brgrds

author: Amr Ibrahim
text:
Derek:

I wanted to ask you about the status of our conversation a few weeks ago.  I 
think we were on the verge of something and would love to hear from you.

Brgrds

AI

author: Janel Guerrero
text: I think this may be the first time I have seen you.  If you are new, welcome to the group.  You may remember me from your meeting with Ken Lay on 8/30/2000.  I am an account executive with Lanebridge Logistics.  I thought it would be nice to call and say hello.

author: Janel Guerrero
text:
I have followed up with Mei on several occasions.  She has been a good 
customer.  I have requested a short call.

author: Janel Guerrero
text:
I think we have some good opportunity ahead of us.  I just got a call from 
Tony at Greenway Landscaping Co. (Raleigh, NC).  He said they are going to 
add a second crew this spring.  I asked him what he was doing with us and 
he said they had never heard of us.  I guess they have never heard of us 
before.  I told him about the fleet telematics and he said he would have to 
give it some thought.  He was a good sport though and agreed to either a 
short call or, at the least, a reply that identified the appropriate person 
to contact.

author: Janel Guerrero
text: Erin - As you know, the prospect is currently framing a 40-home subdivision.  We have a great opportunity to get into that with an engineered lumber package that includes takeoff.  We would like to get Erin's attention to make a short call to her tomorrow or better yet, if she replies with the right contact.

author: Ginger Dernehl
text:
Steve - I think the time is finally right for us to get this thing off the 
ground.  We should make the call next week.

author: Ginger Dernehl
text:
FYI - I just saw a jobs board up for the second shift at Helix.  I have a 
contact in Rockford that I was talking to about a few months ago, but I have 
not heard back from him.  Would you be available for a short call or a reply 
back to the right contact?

author: Ginger Dernehl
text:
Luis,  I got your message this morning.  If you have a minute, I would like 
to talk to you tomorrow.  If not, please let me know and I will get a 
response to you.

author: Ginger Dernehl
text:
Priya,

I wanted to give you a call and discuss some logistics services that we offer.  

I know that you are getting ready to ship some spinach.  I know that you are 
shipping year-round and that you have a reefer equipment issue.  I believe 
that we can help you.  I would like to give you a call next week.  I would 
like to set up a 15-minute call and discuss this in more detail.  I would 
like to give you some details as to why I think that we can help you.  

Thanks,

author: Cheryl Johnson
text:
I know you guys have been busy, so I'm not going to bother you.  But I wanted to call your attention to a quote in the San Jose Mercury News, which is in the San Francisco Bay area.  They are reporting that there is a shortage of reefer capacity for the coming week, as the spinach season is upon us.  I thought you would be interested in the quote.

Cheryl Johnson
Enron Net Works
Global Data Management
713.853.3103

author: Cheryl Johnson
text:
Nadia,

Just a reminder that we are in the market for your used equipment.  If you have any objections, let me know and I will look for the right contact.  

Cheryl

author: Cheryl Johnson
text: I had a call today with Jake, the superintendent at Cedar Point Excavation (Boise, ID).  I had no prior contact with this guy, but he called me out of the blue because they purchased two new excavators this year.  I asked him what he needed and he said, "not a damned thing."  I asked if he would like to get a quote and he said, "why would I want to talk to you?"  I told him I sell GPS machine-control systems for excavators and he said, "maybe I'll give you a call."  I told him I'd like to get a short call with him.  I need to find out how to get this guy on the phone.

author: Cheryl Johnson
text: As I mentioned to you last week, I'm not sure the timing is right for this.  I would like to discuss the possibility of industrial ventilation audits with your facility.  I know the rule is still several months away, but I don't want to miss the opportunity to discuss it.  If you have a minute for a short call, I'd like to talk to you about it.  If not, I'd like to hear your thoughts and maybe we can get the right person on the phone with you.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Walt -

I know you are not a fan of this form of communication but I think it is the only way I can get to you quickly.  I wanted to give you a call to see if I could possibly get you on our fax list.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Derek -

I understand you have a new guy in the purchasing position.  Hopefully, he will be more willing to get together than the guy you had before.  I have been trying to get to you and, so far, all I have been able to get is some voicemails.  I appreciate the call you made earlier this week and I know it was not easy.  I understand you have some new processes being implemented.  My guess is, you are probably not going to get much further than the guy you had before.  He was just not willing to talk to us.  The guy you have now may be willing to take some more time than the guy you had before.  That is probably why I am making this call again.

I appreciate what you have done for me in the past and I understand we are not in a position to go out and get much out of you.  I know you are interested in working with us and I appreciate you calling me.  I know this is not going to be an easy process and I know you are not going to be able to get much more out of me at this point.  I am sure you have a process you want to follow and I appreciate you following it.  I just know if I do not get a reply from you it will be because you are not willing to talk to us.  I understand you are going to be out of the office next week, but I was hoping I would get a reply from you before then.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Carla -

I hope you are doing well.  I wanted to check in on my email to you two weeks ago regarding the maintenance contracts I believe we could provide you.  I wanted to check in and see if we could get a time to talk.  If not, please let me know the appropriate contact.

author: Mark Greenberg
text:
Tony -

I understand that you are not very computer savvy and I don't want you to feel that I am pressuring you to respond right away.  But, I would like to see if we can get together sometime soon - even for a few minutes.  I can always be reached at my cell phone number and would prefer that you contact me via cell phone or by email.

If you can't get together with me soon, please at least let me know who would be the best person to discuss this with.

author: Byron" "Woertz
text:
Joanne,

  I wanted to ask you if we could schedule a 15 minute phone
meeting sometime next week.  We are going to have capacity in the next few
weeks and I wanted to see if we could put it in your wheelhouse.

  Byron Woertz

author: Byron" "Woertz
text:
Angela,

  We are trying to determine if we have a prospect for you. I
have been trying to get a response from you for a few months. If you have
some minutes, I would like to have a quick call with you to determine if we
have a prospect. 

  Byron Woertz
  Director, Client Relations

author: Byron" "Woertz
text:
Kevin,

  I just received word that you broke ground on a mixed use
project downtown.  I am writing to give you a heads-up for us to get you
contacted in a timely manner.  I am sure you will be looking to put up some
temporary fencing and maybe some site security rental.  We will be able to
get you up and running in no time.  If you do not have a contact in your
office for these kinds of services, I would be glad to give you a quick call
to discuss this.  

  Byron Woertz
  Director, Client Relations

author: Byron" "Woertz
text:
Hi Marcus,

  I have received your shipping list and would like to schedule
a call with you.  If you have a few minutes next week, please let me know
when and I will call you.

  Thank you.

  Byron

author: Michelle Cash
text: I just wanted to make a connection with you.  We are in the process of trying to expand our business in the western US and have several contacts that we have had excellent success in the past.  I know you probably don't have time for a meeting or a conference call, but I would like to schedule a 15-minute call next week.

author: Michelle Cash
text: I just wanted to make sure you were aware that I was out of the office today.  I will be here tomorrow morning.  Michelle

author: Michelle Cash
text: Hi, I'm thinking that I should give a call to Mike, the operations manager at Granger Electric in Omaha, NE.  I know he just put a job post up on their web site for a few more guys.  I think I should see what he is interested in.

author: Michelle Cash
text:
I would like to offer our customers the opportunity to use our third party CMM inspection capability.  I realize that you may already have an arrangement in place, but I wanted to make you aware of what I know about our business.  I can call you at your convenience and talk with you a little bit, or I can ask you to send me the right person by replying to this message.

Michelle

author: Vince J Kaminski
text:
Elena,

I am calling you because your aggregates shipping season is coming up.

I know that you normally ship aggregates from the OR area in end-dump or hopper.

I believe that I can quote you the truckload capacity for your aggregates shipment(s).

Let me give you a call next week for 15 minutes.

author: Vince J Kaminski
text:
Rosa,

I would like to reach you for an opportunity to discuss with you a service that
I am able to offer you at Summit Coatings.

I am writing to you for two reasons:

1. I am thinking about you and your business.

2. I am thinking about the new state air-permit rule that is going to take 
effect next year.

author: Vince J Kaminski
text:
Ray,

I am calling you again to follow up on my previous e-mail to you.

author: Vince J Kaminski
text:
Carla,

I have asked to see you by the end of this week.

I will not be getting a good response from you if you don't call me back today.
I would like to schedule a call for you to talk to me about my offer.

author: Elizabeth Sager
text:
Rafael,

I talked to you about this last week, but since you have not had a chance to respond, I wanted to follow-up.  I will do my best to make this work, but I need to get your schedule set up so that I can get on your calendar.

Please give me a call next week so that I can set this up.

author: Elizabeth Sager
text: I need to do a bit of selling soon.

author: Elizabeth Sager
text: I got your e-mail and I'm excited about the opportunity.  I would really like to talk to you on the phone.  If that's too much trouble, a simple 'yes' or 'no' would be fine too.

author: Elizabeth Sager
text:
Dana,
 
I hope all is well with you and your cherries.  I have been following your cherries this year and as we get closer to the season, I thought I would touch base with you.  I know you are looking for truckload capacity for your cherries this year and I wanted to make sure you knew I was listening and that I wanted to talk to you.  I do not think we have talked about this before.  I am just looking for a 15 minute call next week so I can hear more about what you are looking for and so I can put you on our radar.
 
I look forward to hearing from you.

author: Scott Govenar
text:
Dana:

You may have heard of us.  We are a broker of truckload capacity (we
don't own equipment).  Our strength is in our carrier network which is
made up of vetted drivers and equipment.  We are able to quote truckload
capacity out of the WA area.  I understand that you are shipping cherries
to the east coast and I believe that you may be looking to move your
shipments this summer.  I know that cherries usually ship Jun to Aug.  I
have never spoken to you but I would like to talk to you about our
capabilities.  Can we set up a 15-minute call next week?

author: Scott Govenar
text:
Hi Lisa,  I'm calling from Northgate Industrial Partners - I'm the territory
sales manager.  I heard that you guys opened a new bay last quarter.  I'm
sure you're looking for ways to streamline your shop supply process.  I'd
like to talk to you about our MRO supply program.  We have vending cabinets
that we install at no upfront cost to your shop - we just drop them in.  
Then you never have to think about another trip to the warehouse - we take
care of it.  We have a 24/7 operation here in town and we can get your
supplies to you on the next working day.  We also consolidate your monthly
invoicing so you only have to deal with one invoice at a time.  Let's talk
some more on the phone sometime this week or send me a quick e-mail back
with the right contact information.

author: Scott Govenar
text:
I hope you're doing well.  I've been trying to get a hold of Brenda at Oakline
Roofing, but I'm not having any luck.  If you have any information that would
help me reach her, I'd appreciate it.

author: Scott Govenar
text: I would like to speak with you.

text:

Hello Tom,
I am following up on our conversation.  I believe you are right in that we
have a lot of drywall movement.  You had a good point about the fact that
drywall is a seasonal product and we are in the shipping season for that
product.  I will call you to schedule a call next week.

text:
FYI.

Sent: Tuesday, April 17, 2001 1:01 PM

Hey Ray,
I've been trying to reach you on this drywall labor. I was hoping you would
like to talk about it. I understand you are behind on that hospital job.
Well, we understand the business and would like to offer you some help if you
need it.

author: Rick Buy
text: I did write to you about 2 weeks ago and you did not respond. I am not going to keep bugging you but I do want to discuss this further. I think I would like to talk to you on the phone next week.

author: Rick Buy
text: If you have a minute to call I would love to talk with you. I appreciate the time you have spent on this.

author: Rick Buy
text:
Tony- it is nice to hear from you. I am glad you are having success with your 
business. I am not sure what I can offer you. I do know that you added a 
second crew this spring and that you will be putting more trucks and trailers 
on the road. Would you be interested in discussing fleet telematics? I would 
like to have a short call with you or a reply from you to the right person 
around here.

author: Rick Buy
text:
Steve- I would like to talk to you about truckload capacity for your paper 
products shipments.  Why now?  I know that your paper products shipping season 
is coming up soon.  Can we set up a time for a 15 minute phone call next 
week?

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I understand Steve, I will call you next week to set up a time to talk.  
Thanks.
PL

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I heard a few companies are advertising our services on the local jobs board.  
Is there a possibility of a short call or at least a reply with the right 
contact?

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I am hoping you will be the right person to talk with.  I am the outside 
sales rep at Keystone Build Supply.  We are selling you ready-mix delivery 
from a new batch plant.  I was first inquiring with EOL if they could 
possibly provide this report in downloadable format(excel) and they sent me 
to Rahil, who then sent me to you.  Is this possible?  Please feel free to 
contact me for any additional information or if this is really confusing.

author: Phillip M Love
text:
I am hoping you will be the right person to talk with.  Rahil Jafry referred 
me to you.  I am the risk management lead for the Central Gas desk.  
Currently our traders utilize an EOL weighted average gas price report on EOL 
to set their curves for the next gas day, i.e. their curves set today for 
tomorrow's gas flow.  I was first inquiring with EOL if they could possibly 
provide this report in downloadable format(excel) and they sent me to Rahil, 
who then sent me to you.  Is this possible?  Please feel free to contact me 
for any additional information or if this is really confusing.

Please let me know if you are not the right person to contact and I will 
start over with EOL.  Thanks for your assistance in this matter.

author: Stuart Zisman
text: I was in the area and I stopped by to see you.  I would like to have a 15 minute call with you next week.  Please let me know what you think.

author: Stuart Zisman
text: Nadia, I wanted to talk to you about this but thought it might be prudent to wait until you have the opportunity to think about it.

author: Stuart Zisman
text:
Jake,

I have heard about the fact that you recently purchased two new excavators so I thought I would make a few calls.  I think you would be a good prospect to talk to.  I know you are probably busy but if you have a few minutes, I would like to take a quick call.  I know you have a lot going on and I understand that.  If you don't have time to talk, I would really appreciate it if you would let me know who to talk to.  Thanks

author: Stuart Zisman
text: I spoke with Dave Knohl today.  He is not willing to look at an offer unless I can do something to increase the likelihood of his being able to win the project.  I indicated that I would be willing to give him a call if I could get a number for you.
